text: **Hint 1:** When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, it can capture additional patterns in the training data. This often leads to a reduction in the training error because the model becomes more flexible and can fit the training data more closely.\n\n**Hint 2:** Consider how adding a new feature affects the complexity of the model. A more complex model with additional features can fit the training data better, potentially decreasing the Mean Squared Error (MSE) on the training data. However, think about whether this always guarantees a decrease or if there are scenarios where it might not.
